Clark is about to step in; to deny that they're dating because technically, they're not. But before he can get a single word out, Bruce surprises him again. "Clark is…" Bruce begins, pausing as if he's carefully selecting the words that follow. He looks at Clark, and the intensity in his gaze is so overwhelming that Clark feels a warmth spread through him that has nothing to do with the summer heat and everything to do with the man standing next to him. "Clark is good. It's... a privilege to be with someone like him. He sees the best in people. Including people who don't deserve it. Including people who can't even see it in themselves sometimes. He doesn't ask for anything. He gives everything." (Or, Clark and Bruce are having some communication issues. Thankfully, Kara Zor-El is there to save the day.)
